Admission.SettingsPage.Header.Title: Admission sources
Admission.SettingsPage.Policies.Text.Enf: A source in the Block mode denies the request. Kyverno reports blocked requests through Kubernetes events only, so they produce no event in Runtime Radar.
Admission.SettingsPage.Text.ExpertModeDe: You can add your own Kyverno policies and edit the manifests of the existing ones. An invalid manifest is rejected by Kyverno when it is applied.
Admission.SettingsPage.Text.ExpertWarnin: Policy manifests have changed. The whole policy set will be re-applied in the cluster.
Admission.PolicySidepanel.Label.Name: Name
Admission.PolicyForm.Label.Name: Name
Admission.PolicyDeleteModal.Content.Text: The policy will be removed from the cluster after the settings are saved.
Admission.SwitchModeModal.Content.Title: Switch to expert mode?
Admission.SwitchModeModal.Content.Text: In expert mode you edit Kyverno policy manifests directly. An error in a manifest can disable a source or block requests in the cluster.
